output_summary.sql:
WITH revenue_by_year AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN "invoice_date" >= TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01 00:00:00' AND "invoice_date" < TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' THEN 'base'
      WHEN "invoice_date" >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND "invoice_date" < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' THEN 'current'
    END AS period,
    SUM("total") AS revenue
  FROM "public"."invoice"
  WHERE "billing_country" = 'USA'
    AND "invoice_date" >= TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND "invoice_date" < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY period
)
SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'current' THEN revenue END)
   - SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'base' THEN revenue END))
  / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'base' THEN revenue END), 0) * 100 AS yoy_growth_rate
FROM revenue_by_year;
